hard_floors.mechanical_execution: low risk with objective deterministic acceptance only
hard_floors.standard_implementation: never the sole approver of a high-risk financial or privacy change

reviewer_matrix.complex_implementation: independent complex_implementation context or work_package_planning specification review
reviewer_matrix.work_package_planning: schema validation plus complex_implementation feasibility review

provider_diversity.rationale: Cross-family review reduces anchoring but cannot replace deterministic oracles. A hard requirement could deadlock the scheduler.
